about: motion research counter-example: a step-level sender, single-brace and camelCase placeholders, a default, a comment without a Contact variable, no on_reply

errors.hint: Set on_reply to a step id or "end".

errors.rule: step-level by is not supported; use settings.assign
errors.message: step-level by is not supported; use settings.assign
errors.hint: Remove the key: each step kind takes only its own keys, and the sending Account is chosen with settings.assign.

errors.rule: must be a duration between 14d and 180d: a number then m, h or d, like 30d
errors.message: must be a duration between 14d and 180d: a number then m, h or d, like 30d
errors.hint: Set withdraw_after between 14d and 180d, for example 21d.

errors.rule: {FIRST_NAME} is not a variable; write {{contact.<field>}} or remove the braces
errors.message: {FIRST_NAME} is not a variable; write {{contact.<field>}} or remove the braces
errors.hint: Write a variable with double braces, like {{first_name}}, or remove the braces.

errors.rule: unknown variable {{firstName}}; use a field ({{first_name}}), your name ({{my_first_name}}), a custom field ({{opener}}), or contact.<field>, contact.extra.<key>, account.first_name, account.last_name, account.full_name
errors.message: unknown variable {{firstName}}; use a field ({{first_name}}), your name ({{my_first_name}}), a custom field ({{opener}}), or contact.<field>, contact.extra.<key>, account.first_name, account.last_name, account.full_name
errors.hint: Write a variable as {{first_name}}, {{my_first_name}} or a custom field {{opener}}; the long forms {{contact.first_name}}, {{contact.extra.opener}} and {{account.first_name}} work too.

errors.rule: required because the text uses a variable
errors.message: required because the text uses a variable
errors.hint: Add a variable-free fallback: with.fallback, with.note_fallback (or "drop") on an invitation, "skip" on a comment.

errors.rule: variable defaults are not supported; add a fallback
errors.message: variable defaults are not supported; add a fallback
errors.hint: Remove the part after | and add a variable-free fallback on the step instead.

errors.rule: a comment must use a contact variable, such as {{contact.extra.comment}}
errors.message: a comment must use a contact variable, such as {{contact.extra.comment}}
errors.hint: Use a Contact variable in the comment, for example a custom field {{comment}} your AI writes per Contact.
